content.short: Use your favorite offline tool to export your NFT collection as a CSV file and simply import it in Cardano Studio.
content.description: Cardano Studio is a no-account NFT minting tool for creators who want to build Cardano collections without writing code or trusting a third-party custodian. Users can prepare a collection offline, export metadata as a CSV file, and import it into Cardano Studio for minting. The tool lets creators sign and submit their own transactions, supports bundled NFT transactions to reduce fees, and can be used for art, music, and other collectible media on Cardano. It is built for independent creators who want practical minting control while keeping custody of their assets.
content.meta: Cardano Studio helps creators mint Cardano NFT collections from CSV metadata without accounts or code. Explore Cardano Studio on Lancers Web3 Explorer
